The '''''Venture''''' was a [[Courier-class yacht|''Courier''-class]] [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] owned by the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] businessman [[Arend Shen]].<ref name="JOY" />

==Characteristics==
The ''Venture'' was approximately 40 meter long with a aerodynamic silver hull. It was highly modified by Shen for extravagant luxury and maximum speed. It was protected by forward-mounted firelinked light blasters and firelinked light blaster cannon turrets which provided a 180 degree firing arc.<ref name="JOY" />

==Appearances==
*''[[The Jewel of Yavin]]'' {{1st}}
